page: Microsoft Azure F16ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked up to 4.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs without multithreading (1.0 thread per core), coupled with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per-core allocation. Storage is provided locally through an integrated 1888 GB NVMe SSD, while GPU hardware is not included. The underlying CPU architecture incorporates modern vector instruction support, including AVX-512 extensions (AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16).

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate exceptional single-thread capability. In stress-ng single-core tests, the server scores 3786.84, placing in the top tier alongside a Geekbench single-core result of 2741.0. Single-threaded gzip compression reached 41.32 GB/sec, and image processing registered in the top tier at 20245.0. Multi-threaded performance scales robustly across the 16 dedicated cores, with Geekbench multi-core hitting 19953.0 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieving 250.93 GB/sec. For lightweight artificial intelligence tasks, the instance achieves top-tier text generation throughput on small 135M parameter models at 438.13 tokens/sec.

The 1:1 physical core-to-vCPU allocation ensures predictable instruction execution without resource contention from simultaneous multithreading. Paired with high-throughput local NVMe storage and balanced memory bandwidth, the instance delivers high efficiency for compute-bound operations without requiring specialized GPU accelerators. The primary hardware tradeoff is a moderate memory capacity relative to core count and average throughput on highly parallelized database workloads.

This server profile is well matched for compute-heavy workloads that demand high per-core clocks and fast local caching, including software compilation pipelines, web serving clusters, batch data compression, and small-model CPU inference pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure F16ads_v7 is a compute-optimized instance delivering 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running on an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with a peak clock rate of 4.5 GHz. It includes 64.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and bundled high-speed local storage consisting of an 1888 GB NVMe SSD, without attached GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show top-tier single-core CPU execution, leading compression throughput, and strong multi-core scaling in Geekbench. The absence of SMT guarantees uninterrupted compute cycles per core. F16ads_v7 is well suited for CPU-bound microservices, continuous integration and build servers, algorithmic compression pipelines, and CPU-based lightweight machine learning inference.
